title: Renewal and Nonrenewal Figures for RentGuard Tiers
content:
Renewal of a RentGuard Renters Policy runs on five tier figures: how many calendar days before expiration the renewal is billed, how many calendar days after expiration a late renewal payment is still accepted, the paid claims in the lookback window at which the policy becomes eligible for nonrenewal, the length of that lookback window, and the minimum advance notice of nonrenewal.

| Tier | Renewal billed, days before expiration | Late renewal payment accepted, days after expiration | Paid claims in the lookback window that make the policy eligible for nonrenewal | Claims lookback window (months) | Minimum notice of nonrenewal, days before expiration |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 30 | 15 | 3 | 36 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 30 | 15 | 3 | 36 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 30 | 15 | 3 | 36 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 30 | 15 | 3 | 36 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 30 | 30 | 3 | 36 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 30 | 30 | 4 | 36 | 30 |

All day counts are calendar days.

## Guideline notes

- Every tier bills its renewal 30 days before expiration and owes at least 30 days' notice of nonrenewal.
- The late-payment period is 15 days on the four lower tiers and 30 days on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
- HO-4 Signature needs 4 paid claims in the 36-month window before it becomes eligible for nonrenewal; every other tier needs 3.
